searchText: hey everyone 🙂 Sooooo wondering if theres been any push for clients to conform to a standard API (i.e the specification) We have support in a beta branch for eth2 in web3.js and its becoming a bit unreasonable to maintain 4+ different API schemas cc: <@!416370369675395072> https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs See <#710831784991916072> channel Pretty strong momentum for it to be widely adopted Theres a conformance tool maintained by infura And lighthouse has a generally complete implementation here https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pulls
